name: BYTE PHANTOM
realCapabilities: Read-only Windows host inventory: OS, CPU, memory, disk capacity, and IPv4 interface metadata
Active local IPv4 host discovery on directly connected private subnets from /22 through /30, up to 1,022 host targets per scan
ICMP echo reachability plus Windows ARP/neighbor-table MAC enrichment
Continuous network-change monitoring with device arrival, IP-address change, reappearance, and no-longer-visible events
security: Active discovery sends one ICMP echo request per host only within private IPv4 subnets directly attached to this Windows PC; neighbor-table refresh runs every 4 seconds and active rediscovery every 30 seconds. No port scans, credential tests, exploits, internet-wide scans, privilege escalation, or system configuration changes. Not a guaranteed complete router-client inventory; client isolation, sleeping hosts, filtered ICMP, separate VLANs/subnets, and router-specific behavior can limit visibility.
